Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol (w/ Efficient Autosear, Extended Magazine, Pistol Autosear, Pistol Snub Barrel, & Tech Rebuild). Holds 36 rounds. It cannot see or fire through Cover and can only fire in Autofire while charged. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP.

Variant of: Grit
Category: Expensive
Fabrication: DV21 - 500eb - 1 Week
Class: Heavy Pistol
Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Pistol Snub Barrel, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
